data.name: Gray Rush
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Gray Rush is a high-speed 3D running action game where you race through stages while mastering a variety of actions.

Take control of a character who runs forward automatically, and overcome stages filled with obstacles and enemies by using jumps, dashes, wire actions, homing attacks, and more.

High-Speed Running Action

Your character automatically runs through each stage.

Use jumps and various actions depending on the situation to avoid obstacles, defeat enemies, and keep moving forward.

Maintain your speed, chain actions together, and race through each stage.

Upgrade Your Skills During Each Run

Level up during gameplay and choose from multiple skill options to strengthen your character.

Focus on upgrading your favorite actions, or combine multiple abilities to create your own build.

The skills you choose will change the way you play each run.

A Variety of Actions

Use a variety of actions, including high-speed dashes, homing attacks that target enemies from midair, and wire-based movement.

By meeting certain conditions, you can also unlock powerful abilities that go beyond your standard actions.

Combine speed and action to discover your own way to race through each stage.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
